Nearly one in three Indian schools lacked internet access in the 2025–26 academic year. The Education Ministry’s UDISE+ report recorded internet facilities in 67.4% of schools. It lists 14,66,682 schools nationwide, with internet available in 9,89,191. That leaves 4,77,491 schools without it. Starlink could help connect remote schools and give teachers and students access to more learning resources. A child’s opportunities should not depend on whether a broadband cable reaches their classroom. Starlink has already connected more than 6 million students worldwide. This is another powerful reason to support Starlink in India. Media

Sam Altman on the advice from Peter Thiel that mattered most: “ChatGPT was growing super fast, but it felt very unstable, or kind of almost low-value growth.” “A lot of people in the company were like, ‘We gotta figure out something else. This is not sustainable value.’ And we were talking about this list of 5 or 6 other things that we could focus on instead.” “He was like, ‘It's an obvious mistake to do anything but this.’” “Besides the fact that it's growing, which is rare and great, he's like, ‘The power of this is the power of the Google text box. It's like a text box you can type anything into, and it does the right thing.’” “He's like, ‘People have just been chasing the Google business model for 20 years and this is the first thing that's come up, and clearly the empty text box worked for Google, so why don't you just double down on that? It's growing. It's very flexible and it has all of the signs other than it doesn't fit the current Silicon Valley wisdom.’” “So we went super hard on ChatGPT and it was great.” Interested in AI?
